name: 40330 · Harrodsburg, KY
findings: ZIP 40330 (Harrodsburg) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40330 (Harrodsburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 40330 (Harrodsburg) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
